career_ladder.note: Technical Officers and Graduate Engineer Trainees in Electronics Corporation of India Limited (ECIL) advance along the nuclear instrumentation, defence electronics, and strategic communication executive cadre under DPE IDA scales.

steps.source_label: ECIL GET and Technical Officer Recruitment Notification
ECIL Service Regulations (Confirmation on successful training)

steps.designation: Assistant General Manager / Additional General Manager

steps.source_label: ECIL Board Level Senior Management Cadre

exam_scheme.note: Selection comprises a Computer Based Online Test (CBT) followed by a Personal Interview. Final selection is based on consolidated merit giving 85% weightage to CBT score and 15% weightage to Personal Interview.

stages.source_label: ECIL CBT Scheme and Syllabus Guidelines

papers.paper_name: Part A: Technical Discipline Domain Knowledge (ECE / EEE / Mechanical / CSE)
Part B: General Aptitude, Reasoning, Numerical Ability & English Language
Technical & Behavioral Interview before Selection Committee
papers.qualifying_threshold: 60% for General and 50% for Reserved categories

financial_package.note: Executive remuneration in ECIL complies with DPE 3rd PRC IDA scales. Regular GET / Technical Officers enter in Grade E-1 with ₹40,000 starting basic pay, mandatory 58% DA constant as of 2025-07-01, Hyderabad HRA (27%), and cafeteria perks.
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated with Entry Basic Pay ₹40,000, 58% IDA (₹23,200), Hyderabad HRA (27% = ₹10,800) or ECIL residential quarters, and Cafeteria allowances (30% = ₹12,000), less statutory PF (12% Basic+DA) and insurance.
official_perks: Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) revised quarterly per AICPI
House Rent Allowance (HRA) @ 27% in Hyderabad / Company Township Quarters
Cafeteria Approach Perks & Allowances up to 35% of basic pay
Performance Related Pay (PRP) based on annual nuclear & defence division MoU score
Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity, and Defined Superannuation Benefit Scheme
Comprehensive in-house hospital medical coverage for employee and family

competition_benchmarks.note: Recruitment benchmarks compiled from ECIL notifications and shortlists.
